resources.string: Lets Osmin on your computer show this phone\'s screen and control it with the mouse and the keyboard.
Keep this app installed, then connect from the Osmin panel on your computer: open the Phone card and follow it.
Wireless debugging must be on in Settings, Developer options, and the phone must be in the same network as the computer (a network that either of them shares is fine).
The picture and the touches go only between this phone and the computer you connect, on your own network. Nothing is sent to the internet.
